entities.name: Start of the Ice Age
entities.description: End of the Dark Age and start of the Ice Age on Terisiare, officially 450 AR.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church that dissolved at the start of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: Glacier that filled the Lat-Nam Straits.

entities.name: Lat-Nam Straits
entities.description: Straits filled by the Great Glacier.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: School whose scholars built a new campus, a hidden refuge for spellcasters.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Nation taken over by the Rigida.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: First glacier of Terisiare, which expanded south.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: Buried under ice; Soldev later founded on its ruins.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Giant forest that thrived on the shores by old Kroog.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Hardy people who replaced the old city-states, capital Kjeld.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Fertile land risen from the sea.

events.summary: In 450 AR the Church of Tal dissolves and the cold grips the continent, marking the official start of the Ice Age.
events.quote: 450 AR marks the official start of the era of ice

events.summary: The Great Glacier fills the Lat-Nam Straits and the City of Shadows is abandoned; its scholars build the School of the Unseen.
events.quote: The City of Shadows had to be abandoned to the ice
eventually burying it under tons of ice

events.summary: Kjeldorans replace the old city-states and found Kjeld.
events.quote: a hardy people known as Kjeldorans
